𖦹 my favourite ways to wind down
after an overwhelming day

1. a long shower with music.

wash the day off, literally.

2. write down three things that went okay.

even tiny ones.
the day was not all bad.

3. tidy one small corner.

a clean desk feels like a clean head.

4. tea and a window.

ten minutes watching the sky.
no phone.

5. something gentle to think about.

before, i scrolled until my brain buzzed.
now i learn one new thing every morning. and i end the day with one calm, interesting story.
